title: Warmwind runs any software in your browser like a human does
description:
Try Warmwind → https://warmwind.com
Watch the full launch video → https://youtu.be/x_ST4jvZk_A

Warmwind just launched, a cloud worker that runs in your browser and uses software exactly like a human does.

Warmwind is an AI operating system: instead of calling APIs, it clicks, types and reads the screen, which means it works with any software you already use, including the tools that never had an API or an integration.

You give Warmwind a task in plain language, or you turn on teaching mode and show it the workflow once, and it repeats that work on its own while you are asleep.

People are using Warmwind to organize expenses, gather invoices and run the repetitive admin that used to need a full-time virtual assistant.

Because Warmwind runs in the cloud, you do not leave a machine on at home and you do not babysit the run.

The Warmwind team also published a full launch video on the Warmwind channel showing the cloud worker running a real task end to end, so you can watch it work before you build anything.

Head to warmwind.com to create your first worker.

#warmwind #aiagents #automation #cloudworker #ai

Paid partnership with Warmwind.
